selection_rule: Prioritize primary instruments and observed implementation before new doctrine or registry expansion.

work_items.risk: The MA branch can still falsely complete if a denial/remedy/payment row starts after enrollment and ignores broker/TPMO/HCP steering, marketing complaints, plan universe distortion, disability/complex-care avoidance, and Medigap exit lock-in.
work_items.deliverable: Acquire or construct one current beneficiary/contract/PBP/service/request row that joins enrollment provenance, broker/TPMO/HCP compensation and marketing incentives, plan universe presented, complaint/correction status, Medigap guaranteed-issue and underwriting barriers, denial/access/remedy/payment, encounter/benefit-use, clinical correctness, subgroup, RADV/payment-integrity, and public-cost incidence.
work_items.acceptance_test: Reject any row that fills denial, appeal, encounter, payment, or benefit-use fields while leaving enrollment_event_id, broker_or_agent_npn, tpmo_or_lead_generator_id, compensation/marketing payment markers, plan_universe_presented, complaint/correction, medigap_guaranteed_issue_status, medigap_underwriting_barrier, and exit_to_traditional_medicare_feasibility blank.
work_items.remaining_blocker: The row lock is now explicit, but no actual current contract/PBP/benefit/request/encounter/payment/remedy row has been acquired.
work_items.next_unblocked_step: Build the first certifying-row fixture from SNF or home-health/post-acute MA data: join contract/PBP and benefit design to Part C request/denial, encounter service trace, payment/cost-sharing source, supplemental-benefit use/denial, risk/RADV context, beneficiary subgroup, access state, and restoration outcome.
next_steps: Use MBSF or equivalent to attach dual/LIS, disability-entitlement, race/ethnicity, age, sex, county/place, and Part C enrollment denominators to one contract-service-month row.
Join Part C denial/appeal/remedy and contractor/resident fields to the same subgroup row.
Join MCBS/CAHPS/MMD/Star Ratings/EHO4All status as context, not substitutes; disclose suppression and linkage limits.
Join program audit result, enforcement action, RADV/payment, and restoration outcome when present.

work_items.risk: Current-law Treasury/JCT estimates can be mistaken for proof of final claimant incidence or public-loss allocation; preference-level incidence, interactions, direct alternatives, and recovery terms remain unresolved.
work_items.deliverable: Top-ten preference claimant-incidence ledger with statutory anchors, interaction-adjusted package estimate, direct-spending counterfactual, and recapture/phaseout/minimum-tax/sunset terms.
next_steps: Bind statutory section and current-law estimate for each top-ten Treasury FY2027 preference.
Attach CBO/JCT distribution by income and wealth, expanding to race, age, place, tenure, and filing status where primary evidence permits.
Build an interaction-adjusted package estimate and direct-spending counterfactual.
Identify public-upside recovery, recapture, phaseout, minimum-tax, or sunset terms.

work_items.risk: Aggregate public pension assets and headline private-equity returns can hide plan-level fee drag, valuation lag, illiquidity, capital calls, and service/tax/worker incidence.
work_items.deliverable: Bind one large plan or state system to audited private-market fee/carry, unfunded commitment, capital-call, distribution, NAV/valuation, legal-priority, and contribution/service-incidence records.
work_items.acceptance_test: At least one plan-level waterfall distinguishes workers, retirees, taxpayers, service users, future residents, bondholders, and manager fee/carry claims; certified_current remains false unless legal priority and net-of-fee incidence are proven.

work_items.risk: Rev0364 identifies the PS-01/PS-02 data architecture, but the cube still cannot certify without final forms/rules, actual issuer filings, public access/aggregates, failure priority, and public-upside recovery.
work_items.deliverable: Actual-filing/public-disclosure tracker plus public-upside term sheet for any public-liquidity support.
work_items.acceptance_test: At least eight additional locator-bound edges from final forms/rules, OMB/PRA disposition, first issuer/aggregate reports, and any facility/recovery instruments; verdict remains not_certified_current absent explicit loss allocation and upside recovery.
work_items.remaining_blocker: Final forms/rules and actual filings/public disclosure are absent; recovery instrument is absent.

work_items.risk: Rev0365 proves a measurable private-credit risk perimeter, but the cube can still overclaim unless it binds actual Form PF/currentness outcomes, redemption/valuation stress records, counterparty concentration, and public-liquidity/no-bailout terms.
work_items.deliverable: Private-credit actual-data tracker plus stress-loss/public-upside term sheet.
work_items.acceptance_test: At least eight additional locator-bound edges from final Form PF action, official aggregate/fund data, redemption/valuation records, counterparty concentration, and any facility/no-bailout/public-upside instruments; verdict remains not_certified_current absent explicit loss allocation and recovery terms.
work_items.remaining_blocker: Actual data, claimant incidence, and public-upside/no-bailout instruments are absent.

work_items.risk: Rev0367 proves a live residual-insurance/NFIP/FAIR Plan/Citizens/mortgage-stress perimeter, but the cube can still overclaim unless it binds assessment statutes, loss waterfalls, reinsurance attachment, NFIP debt/mitigation records, renter/mortgage incidence, and public-upside or mitigation-recovery terms.
work_items.deliverable: Residual-insurance loss-waterfall table plus NFIP debt/reinsurance/mitigation tracker and public-upside acceptance test.
work_items.acceptance_test: At least ten additional locator-bound edges from state assessment statutes, residual-plan financials/reinsurance/cat bonds, NFIP financial statements/reinsurance/mitigation records, mortgage-credit incidence, renter pass-through, and public recovery terms; verdict remains not_certified_current absent explicit loss allocation and public-upside/mitigation recovery.

work_items.risk: Rev0366 proves a current Treasury basis/repo/clearing risk perimeter, but the cube can still overclaim unless it binds actual proxy-series data, margin/repo stress incidence, clearing implementation records, and public-upside/no-bailout terms.

work_items.acceptance_test: At least eight additional locator-bound edges from OFR/CFTC/Form PF data extraction, SEC clearing implementation records, repo/margin stress incidence, clearing default-management/loss-allocation terms, and any public market-functioning support instrument; verdict remains not_certified_current absent explicit loss allocation and public-upside recovery.

work_items.risk: Rev0363 proves a statutory perimeter, but the cube can still overclaim comfort if it lacks final rules, issuer reserve/custody data, redemption/insolvency priority, stress-liquidation assumptions, and public-upside recovery.
work_items.deliverable: Final-rule tracker plus issuer reserve/custody disclosure matrix, redemption/suspension and insolvency priority map, Treasury/MMF stress channel, and public-upside recovery term sheet.
work_items.acceptance_test: At least eight additional locator-bound edges from final rules and issuer/facility records; verdict must remain not_certified_current absent explicit stress-loss and public-upside allocation.
work_items.remaining_blocker: Final rules, issuer records, and public-liquidity/recovery instruments are absent.

work_items.risk: The cube can now prove the FinCEN domestic-entity gap, but could still overclaim opacity if other federal/state/tax/procurement/banking rails identify controllers.
work_items.deliverable: A BOI alternative-rail matrix covering final rule/litigation status, state registries, tax ownership returns, procurement disclosures, CDD, real-property records, and trust/legal-arrangement reporting.
work_items.acceptance_test: At least six locator-bound edges distinguishing no-rail, partial rail, nonpublic authority rail, and public/claimant rail; verdict still not certified unless domestic control visibility is adequate and durable.
work_items.remaining_blocker: No alternative domestic beneficial-owner visibility rail has been audited yet.

work_items.risk: The cube now has the 2026 BEA/GST numbers but can still fail by using law amounts without filing instructions, SOI lags, or incidence/exemption-use evidence.
work_items.deliverable: Claim edges from current Form 706/Form 709 instructions, final §2010 guidance if issued, SOI estate/gift tables, and exemption-use incidence by wealth tier.
work_items.acceptance_test: At least five locator-bound edges separating BEA, GST, annual exclusion, portability, filing obligations, and observed estate/gift filing patterns.
work_items.remaining_blocker: Forms, final guidance, and incidence crosswalk are not yet migrated.

work_items.risk: The case can prove public benefits and still fail if parent guarantee, ESA, CIAC, or financing terms allow fallback recovery from ratepayers.

work_items.acceptance_test: At least four primary-document edges with clauses and a clear conclusion on fallback recovery, seniority, and Commission authority.
work_items.remaining_blocker: No primary guarantee/ESA/financing documents are yet bound.

work_items.risk: The U.S. case can be numerically current while still failing the mission by treating net worth shares as command power or durable independence.

work_items.acceptance_test: A claim packet that separates official net-worth shares from usable wealth, control wealth, and policy-instrument implications.
work_items.remaining_blocker: No liquid/control/encumbrance crosswalk is bound yet.
